Tap the map to move the placemark.
Tap the map to add a vertex. Tap a draft pin to move that vertex. Undo reverses your last edit.
Tap the map to place the selected vertex.
No objects in this area. Add one or move the map.
Showing the first 1,000 objects in this area. Zoom in to narrow the results.
Check the geometry: a marker needs one point, a line needs two distinct points, and a polygon needs at least three distinct vertices without crossing edges.
Could not load map objects. Try again.
Could not save map objects. Your edits are still available. Check available storage and retry.
An object can contain up to 1,000 vertices.

Paste GeoJSON or GPX 1.0/1.1 XML. GPX waypoints become markers; routes and track segments become lines. Names and descriptions are kept; elevation, timestamps, and extensions are ignored. Import adds copies with new IDs. Limits: 4 MB, 1,000 objects, and 1,000 points per object.
Select and copy the GeoJSON below. It includes all objects in this map.
Unsupported or invalid GeoJSON or GPX. Check coordinates, names, descriptions, and limits: 4 MB, 1,000 objects, 1,000 points per object. Routes and track segments need two distinct points.
Could not export GeoJSON. Export supports up to 1,000 objects and 4 MB.
These objects cannot be separated further at the available zoom. Choose an object to view its details. Some may be outside the visible map.
